query: I have a 56‑year‑old female on invasive mechanical ventilation. Among female ICU patients aged 51–61, what percentile is an instability score of 80 in the first 48 hours? Also report ICU LOS and mortality for the most unstable decile.
final_sql: WITH mortality_stats AS (SELECT subject_id, COUNT(*) filter (WHERE date_of_death IS NOT NULL) AS death_count, percent_rank() filter (WHERE date_of_death IS NOT NULL) AS death_percent_rank FROM mortality GROUP BY subject_id) SELECT percentile_cont(0.8) within GROUP (ORDER BY death_count) AS mortality_percentile, percent_rank() within GROUP (ORDER BY death_count) AS mortality_percent_rank, lag(death_count) OVER (PARTITION BY subject_id ORDER BY intime) AS previous_death_count FROM mortality_stats;
